data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-r-r', meaning 'to be free from sins, virtuous'. In Islamic tradition, Bareerah is a name given to women of exceptional moral character. The name Bareerah carries the meaning “Free from sin, virtuous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bareerah usually hope their child will grow to embody free from sin, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In essence, Bareerah symbolizes the ideal Muslim woman and serves as an inspiration to young girls and women to strive towards virtuous living.
